C1389.title: Mirai Creators Plead Guilty and Assist FBI in Cybercrime Investigations
C1389.summary: In December 2017, Paras Jha, Josiah White, and Dalton Norman—the three creators of the Mirai botnet—pleaded guilty to building and hijacking hundreds of thousands of IoT devices for large-scale DDoS attacks. They subsequently cooperated with the FBI in investigating other cybercrime cases, including the Kelihos botnet and Memcached-based DDoS attacks.
